snippet.title: False Hero - Trailer 2
snippet.description:
False Hero is a fast-paced soulslike adventure where you imitate your enemies’ attacks and chain them together into deadly combos. All lands have fallen to Death and been corrupted beyond repair. Let them live on, or destroy them once and for all.

You can wishlist it on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2538870/False_Hero/
